# Takayuki Ito (伊藤孝行)

> Personal academic homepage of Takayuki Ito, Professor at the Department of Social Informatics, Graduate School of Informatics, Kyoto University, Japan. His research covers multi-agent systems, automated negotiation, collective intelligence, AI-supported consensus building and online deliberation (the D-Agree / "Hyperdemocracy" line of work), computational mechanism design, and LLM agents.

Key facts:
- Name: Takayuki Ito (Japanese: 伊藤孝行, いとう たかゆき). Doctor of Engineering, Nagoya Institute of Technology, 2000.
- Position: Professor, Kyoto University (since October 2020). Previously at Nagoya Institute of Technology (2003–2020; full professor from 2014) and JAIST (2001–2003).
- Visiting positions: USC/ISI (2000–2001), Harvard University and MIT Center for Coordination Science (2005–2006), MIT Center for Collective Intelligence (2008–2010).
- Selected awards: Prizes for Science and Technology by the Minister of MEXT (2013, 2026); MEXT Young Scientists' Prize (2007); JSPS Prize (2014); Best Paper Award at AAMAS 2006; 2023 Gregory Kersten GDN Journal Best Paper Award.
- Service: board member of IFAAMAS; PC Chair of AAMAS 2013 and PRIMA 2009, General Chair of PRIMA 2014; Associate Member of the Science Council of Japan.
- Identifiers: ORCID 0000-0001-5093-3886; DBLP pid 24/1535-1.
- Contact: ito [at] i.kyoto-u.ac.jp

All pages contain their full content as static HTML. English pages are listed first; each has a Japanese counterpart with the suffix `-j.html`.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://takayuki-ito.com/): profile, recent news, selected papers, biography, research interests, selected awards, contact
- [Home (Japanese)](https://takayuki-ito.com/index-j.html): 日本語トップページ（略歴表を含む）
- [Publications](https://takayuki-ito.com/publications.html): complete list of journal papers, conference papers, invited talks, books, patents and awards, by year
- [Top-tier conference papers](https://takayuki-ito.com/publications-top-confs.html): papers at AAAI, IJCAI, AAMAS, ACL, EMNLP, ICML, KDD, SIGMOD and ACM Collective Intelligence
- [News](https://takayuki-ito.com/news.html): paper acceptances, awards, invited talks and media coverage
- [Awards](https://takayuki-ito.com/awards.html): awards and honors
- [Professional activities](https://takayuki-ito.com/activity.html): conference chairing, society boards, editorial boards, program committees
- [Teaching](https://takayuki-ito.com/lecture.html): courses taught, by academic year
